# Caravan release-parser corpus.
#
# PLAN.md standing rule: this corpus only ever grows. Every parser bug found in
# any phase adds an entry here BEFORE the fix lands.
#
# Format, one case per line:
#
#   <release name> | key=value; key=value; ...
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. The name and the
# expectation are separated by " | " (space pipe space).
#
# Keys: title, year, season, episodes (comma separated), quality, source,
# codec, audio, bitdepth, group, proper, repack, edition, container, minconf,
# maxconf.
#
# Omitted keys are asserted as zero values, EXCEPT quality and source, which
# default to "unknown" (what the parser returns when it recognizes neither).
# So every field the parser must NOT populate is checked by omission.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- movies ----

# ------------------------------------------- unsupported shapes (degrade) ----
# Anime absolute numbering is explicitly out of scope (SPEC §16). These must
# come back low-confidence and intact, never as a wrong episode number.

# Daily-dated episodes are out of scope too: the date reads as a year.

# ----------------------------------------------------------- bit depth ------
# SPEC §8: the TV profile check needs to tell 10-bit video from 8-bit, because
# a Main10 stream is exactly what an older set refuses to decode.
Some.Movie.2021.2160p.WEB-DL.HEVC.10bit.DDP5.1-GRP | title=Some Movie; year=2021; quality=2160p; source=webdl; codec=hevc; audio=EAC3; bitdepth=10; group=GRP; minconf=1
Another.Movie.2019.1080p.BluRay.x264.8bit.AAC-GRP | title=Another Movie; year=2019; quality=1080p; source=bluray; codec=x264; audio=AAC; bitdepth=8; group=GRP; minconf=1
# Hi10P is the anime spelling of the same claim, and it has to be cut out of
# the title like every other technical tag.
[Anime-Group] Cool Show - 03 [Hi10P][720p][x264].mkv | title=Cool Show - 03; quality=720p; codec=x264; bitdepth=10; group=Anime-Group; container=mkv; minconf=0.5; maxconf=0.6
